application.name: YOLO26 Detection
application.description: End-to-end YOLO26 object detection on the GPU with a reusable Holoscan 5 operator: CUDA letterbox, TensorRT inference through the SDK's HoloInfer library, and GPU decoding into boxes in image pixels with scores, classes and a count.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: Yolo26DetectionOp for RGB8, BGR8, RGBA8 and BGRA8 images in GPU or host memory; synthetic and JPEG/PPM image sources; a report with ground truth, expected detections, latency and annotated PPM output; a stub model for model-free tests.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

data.name: YOLO26n (Ultralytics, AGPL-3.0)
data.description: Not part of this repository. The application-local prepare_model.py downloads the pinned weights and exports them to ONNX with the separately installed Ultralytics tool. Needed by the demo and files modes only.

data.name: COCO val2017 image 000000039769
data.description: A sample image that prepare_model.py downloads for the demo and the real-model tests.

demo.description: Detect objects in the prepared sample image with YOLO26n, 300 times, printing its detections once and the latency per frame.

files.description: Detect objects in each JPEG and PPM image in the data directory once with YOLO26n, printing the detections and writing each image with its boxes drawn to the build directory.

ci.description: Finite headless check without downloads: 30 synthetic BGR8 frames through TensorRT with the stub model, which stands in for YOLO26, every detection checked against the frame's known ones.
